surface: Showcase Network and Framework JSON key-path selection
reproduction: Use a JSON object containing both a literal key named `feeds.news` and a nested object `feeds: { news: ... }`, with distinct values.
Select the literal dotted key in the Showcase Network JSON tree and run extraction; repeat with the Showcase Framework tree.
Compare the selected result with the literal key's value and with the separately selectable nested path.
expected: A selected JSON object key remains one path segment even when its literal name contains dots. The nested path `feeds` then `news` remains a distinct selection. Saved/reopened Network and Framework recipes return the selected value rather than silently routing to the other shape.
actual: Source constructs JsonTree child paths by concatenating keys with `.` and both consumers parse the resulting string by splitting on `.`. Selecting the single key `feeds.news` therefore produces the same path string as selecting nested keys `feeds` then `news`; extraction resolves the nested value and cannot address the literal dotted key through this UI path.
source_evidence: src/components/ui/json-tree.tsx:134-135 builds childPath as `${path}.${key}` without escaping or segment encoding.

src/features/showcase/tabs/NetworkTab.tsx:66-70 passes the selected key-path string to rowsFromBody; src/lib/data-pattern/run-interactive.ts:268-281 performs split-based traversal for Network extraction and replay.
src/lib/data-pattern/modes/next-data.ts:339-344 traverses cfg.key_path.split('.'); FrameworkTab.tsx:144-153 passes the JsonTree path into the next_data mode.
severity: S2: selected extraction can silently return a different JSON value when literal dotted keys coexist with nested paths.
priority: P2: affects key-path correctness in Network and Framework modes; installed public-page acceptance remains open.
reproduction_status: Guarded baseline assertion reproduced the wrong row: clicking the literal feeds.news key returned the distinct nested feed row. The Network save sanitizer also dropped array paths before repair.
verification_status: Engineering fix: guarded six-file focused suite passed 28/28 after frozen install, and TypeScript compile passed. Independent installed public-page T56 acceptance remains open; no native D46 verification has run.

transition_history.reason: Source reading confirmed that JsonTree encodes object keys in a dotted string and Network/Framework consumers split the string, making a literal dotted key ambiguous with a nested path.

The literal-key wrong-value baseline and dropped Network save path were reproduced. Exact segment selection, both runners, and credential-safe persistence were repaired; the real query mapping and focused regression suite passed. Native public-page acceptance remains open.

closure_requirement: Add a regression using distinct literal-dotted and nested values through the actual JsonTree selection and both extraction consumers, then verify an installed development build on a real public page with the same shape. Confirm save/reopen preserves each segment boundary.
